clock_meridiem_night: The NIGHT daypart is a midnight-crossing BAND in colloquial clock usage,
not a uniform +12 PM shift: "la una de la nit" is 01:00, "les deu de la
nit" is 22:00, twelve is midnight 00:00.  Small hours 1..5 stay AM, evening
hours 6..11 are PM, twelve is midnight (band-split in resolver _clock_hms).
AM ceiling follows the madrugada band [00:00, 06:00) transcribed for ca in
chronologia/dayparts.py; Diccionari de la llengua catalana (DIEC2), s.v.

marker_at_counts: Clock prepositions that also introduce a counted group: a bare hour behind one
is doubtful only right before a word of marker_counted_noun.voc.  Attested in
the parity acceptance rows; no dictionary source checked, a native reviewer is to confirm.
marker_between: Catalan range "between" framing (entre A i B).
"entre": DIEC2 (IEC), s.v. "entre" (preposicio) -- denota situacio o estat
enmig de dos termes ("entre juny i agost"). Pairs with marker_and ("i").
marker_counted_noun: Nouns that count people or things a clock never takes: a bare hour behind a
clock preposition and directly before one of them is a count ("wave at 5
people").  Each word is quoted from its Wiktionary Noun entry
(https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/<word>); the fetched pages are kept with the audit.
marker_date_article: The article that opens the day of an event: "el 29", "el dia 29", and a
weekday with its date, "el dijous 5 de gener".
"Per expressar el dia en què s’esdevé un fet s’utilitza l’article masculí el o bé
l’expressió el dia" (Universitat de Barcelona, Llibre d'estil, criteri 2800,
The same criterion leaves the article out of "dijous passat" and "dijous
vinent", but speech often keeps it ("el vinent divendres"), and the
article then still opens the date.

marker_during: "al" (a + el) is the usual frame for a calendar month
Source: Diccionari de la llengua catalana, https://dlc.iec.cat/.
marker_from: Catalan range "from" lead -- opens a bounded or open interval and, crucially,
disambiguates the hyper-common preposition "a" (marker_to) as a genuine range
boundary: a bare "A a B" is only trusted as a range when a "from" lead is present.
"de": DIEC2 (IEC), s.v. "de" (preposicio) -- origen / punt de partenca,
correlativa d'"a" ("de juny a agost"). Optimot, fitxa "de ... a".
"des de": GEIEC / Gramatica de la llengua catalana (IEC), s.v. "des de"
(locucio prepositiva) -- punt d'origen en el temps o l'espai ("des de 2010").
"a partir de": Optimot -- locucio prepositiva, punt de comencament.
"del": contraccio obligatoria de la preposicio "de" + l'article "el"
(IEC, Gramatica de la llengua catalana, 16.3; DIEC2 s.v. "del"). Es la
forma escrita corrent de l'inici d'un interval: "del 5 al 12 de juny".
marker_future: "d'aquí a" fronts a future offset ("d'aquí a cinc dies" = in five days):
Wiktionary (en), d'aquí a, Catalan preposition, "in, within (a time span)".
marker_half: clock/adjectival "mitja/mig" plus period noun "meitat" (cadascuna de les dues parts iguals) -- IEC, Diccionari de la llengua catalana (DIEC2), s.v. "meitat".
marker_hour_statement: The verb that states the hour, with its article: "són les 15h", "és la
una".  "hora [...] 2 1 Temps del dia expressat en hores comptades des de
mitjanit o des de migdia i en fraccions d'hora. ─Quina hora és? ─Són les
tres o són tres hores." (IEC, DIEC2, s.v. "hora", 2 1).
marker_oclock: "a les set hores" = at seven o'clock; the plural noun closes a clock hour
the way Portuguese "horas" does.  Wiktionary, hora (Catalan), "hour".
marker_to: Catalan range "to" boundary -- the term / upper limit of a bounded interval.
"a": DIEC2 (IEC), s.v. "a" (preposicio) -- terme o punt d'arribada, correlativa
de "de" ("de juny a agost"). Optimot, construccio "de ... a".
"fins a" / "fins": DIEC2 (IEC), s.v. "fins" (preposicio) -- limit de temps,
lloc o quantitat ("de juny fins a agost"). GEIEC, "fins (a)".
"al": contraccio obligatoria de la preposicio "a" + l'article "el"
(IEC, Gramatica de la llengua catalana, 16.3; DIEC2 s.v. "al").
Correlativa de "del" en la construccio "del ... al ...".
